snippet.title: Shelley Duvall's Tales Of Digby The Dog (1994) [PC] longplay
snippet.description:
Tales of Digby is an educational adventure game released in 1994. It follows the adventures of Digby, a one-pound Yorkshire Terrier.
The game consists of three separate stories, each featuring animated sequences, hidden surprises, songs, and mini-games. To start a new story, you must select one of three exits on one of the screens.
The first story tells of Digby's owner taking him to a dog show, but he runs away and tries to find his way home with the help of Bertram. In the second story, Digby gets lost in the woods, meets Scoonly, and heads home. The third story tells of Digby getting lost and meeting Daffy and Lizzie, who help him find his owners.
The game features fun games and activities, original songs, an interactive music studio, and important lessons about problem solving, teamwork, and the importance of family.
